evidence.pendingLine1: After scoring and reviewing the feedback, click “Record this learning result” to turn the answer into learning-profile evidence.
evidence.pendingLine2: Hint usage is recorded accurately; unanswered, skipped and failed evaluations are never counted as wrong.
evidence.recordedLine1: This answer has been turned into formal learning evidence, and the concept's mastery was projected from the score with the hint discount applied.
evidence.recordedLine2: Open “My learning profile” at any time to see long-term mastery and review intervals.
evidence.title: Feedback & evidence

generator.allowFallback: Allow model knowledge when no materials are available

generator.continuationHint: The new question follows the previous one; earlier questions and scores stay unchanged.

next.hint: Continues the same concept by default; the next step lets you change the concept, question type and learning goal.
next.title: Keep practising

notes.line1: Practice follows the current learning goal and checkpoint: answer on your own, understand the feedback, then record the evidence and schedule the review.
notes.line2: Reference answers, scoring criteria and the knowledge basis are stored with the question in the local learning record and used only server-side; the page shows only the question itself.
notes.line3: Correct answers with hints and without hints are recorded separately; unanswered, skipped and failed scoring are never counted as wrong.
notes.title: How practice works
